description: Sheogorath entropy engine — Xul-fold possibility generator, CHEESE reinforcement scoring, and NPC personality factory. Candidate states only; no factual authority.

imagine.description: Generate candidate idea states from a prompt using entropy-weighted divergence.

cheese.description: Score a candidate on the CHEESE reinforcement signal (novelty × coherence geometric mean).
cheese.eliza: plan() → wrong/right annotations on the candidate

expand.description: Return n semantic associations that maximise distance from the input concept.

npc.description: Generate a deterministic NPC personality profile from a seed string.

health.description: Return micronaut health: CHEESE balance, Jyggalag threshold, ELIZA wiring status.

reinforcement.note: Candidates below 0.85 coherence are dropped during Jyggalag total-order collapse (JYGG-1 greymarch).

folds.Xul: entropy emission — candidate generation, divergence, CHEESE reward
folds.Chen: ELIZA metacognitive interpretation of imagination output

integration.ELIZA-1: intent classification constrains temperature; plan() annotates CHEESE output
integration.JYGG-1: greymarch receives SHEOG-1 candidates; drops below coherence threshold
